method: Whole production frequency hub in fresh Node VMs; actual native library render/apply handlers, AudioLife object, frStart lifecycle wrapper and SukunVoiceAttempt guards. FR graph, DOM, storage, speech and foreground session dependencies use explicit controlled seams with allocation/call-count/intent-epoch assertions.
limitations: Controlled FR graph seams establish controller routing and idempotence, not actual Web Audio rendering, autoplay permission or audible output.
Controlled keyboard events exercise actual handlers but do not establish native focus, user activation or browser default-action behavior.
Actual AudioLife/VoiceAttempt epoch checks do not execute native recordings, TTS, the outer background renderer, browser media events or a live dhikr counter.
